name: Nanase Shii
source:
"A sister whose true identity is unknown. A honey trap"

The mysterious sister. Outwardly, a computer programmer. Rumored to be a highly skilled agent in secret.

Possessing the ruthlessness of a professional, yet now fighting with her life to protect her precious brother! Is she enemy or ally?

She is incredibly good at hiding her presence.
